description: Figure 7 (right panel) is a grouped bar chart illustrating the CoLeG-R performance metric (expressed as a percentage) for three different LLaMA-2 model scales — LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B — as they are fine-tuned on increasingly larger supervised fine-tuning (SFT) datasets. The horizontal axis categorizes the models by scale, while the vertical axis represents CoLeG-R (%) ranging from 0 to 50, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. For each model scale, four bars are grouped together, corresponding to four training conditions: “no SFT” (light blue, solid fill), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange, diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (purple, cross-hatch pattern), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink, solid fill), as indicated in the legend. The chart shows a clear upward trend in CoLeG-R as both model size and SFT dataset scale increase: for the 7B model, CoLeG-R rises from approximately 5% (no SFT) to ~30% (full SFT); for the 13B model, it increases from ~10% to ~40%; and for the 70B model, it climbs from ~25% to over 50%. This visual pattern supports the caption’s conclusion that scaling up both model size and SFT dataset leads to improved CoLeG-R performance.
